platforms.name: Facebook
platforms.seoDescription: Paste a public Facebook video or Reel link into ReelFetch. Download a listed quality when Facebook returns a file. Private posts are not saved.
platforms.headline: Download public Facebook videos and Reels
platforms.intro: Use ReelFetch when you have a public Facebook watch, Reel, or video link and you are allowed to keep a copy. The tool shows only the qualities that link returns.
steps: Open the public Facebook video or Reel and copy its link.
Paste the link into the downloader above and choose Find Video.
Select a listed quality, then save the file with your browser.
platforms.note: fb.watch and facebook.com/share links are accepted when they resolve to a public video. A recognized link can still fail if the post is private, removed, or region-limited.
troubleshooting: Make sure the post audience is set to Public. Friends-only or private group videos cannot be accessed.
If using a facebook.com/share/r/ or fb.watch link, verify it opens in an incognito browser window without logging in.
Videos larger than 512 MB are rejected to keep server transfers reliable.

faqs.question: Which Facebook links can ReelFetch check?
faqs.answer: Public watch, Reel, and video links, including fb.watch addresses that point at a public video. Private posts and login-only videos are not downloaded.

faqs.question: Does every Facebook link include Full HD?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch lists the formats Facebook returns for that link. Full HD appears only when that video actually offers it.

faqs.question: Is ReelFetch affiliated with Facebook?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is an independent tool and is not endorsed by Meta or Facebook.

platforms.name: YouTube
platforms.seoDescription: Check a public YouTube video or Shorts link and save a quality YouTube provides. Private, deleted, and blocked videos are not downloaded.
platforms.headline: Download public YouTube videos and Shorts
platforms.intro: Paste a public YouTube or youtu.be link to see the download options that video exposes. ReelFetch does not bypass private videos, age gates, or region blocks.
steps: Copy the public YouTube video or Shorts URL.
Paste it into the downloader above and choose Find Video.
Download one of the available qualities shown for that video.
platforms.note: YouTube may change which formats a video offers. If a quality is missing from the list, ReelFetch cannot invent it.
troubleshooting: Confirm the video is Public (not Private, Members-only, or Age-restricted) and playable without signing in.
Live streams currently in progress cannot be downloaded until the broadcast finishes and is archived.
If a 1080p or higher stream is selected, the server merges video and audio into MP4 using FFmpeg before streaming.

faqs.question: Can I download a YouTube Short the same way as a normal video?
faqs.answer: Yes, when the Short is public. Paste the Shorts link, review the listed qualities, and download one of them.

faqs.question: Will every YouTube link be downloadable?
faqs.answer: No. Private, deleted, members-only, age-gated, and geographically restricted videos can fail even when the URL looks valid.

faqs.question: Is ReelFetch an official YouTube app?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by YouTube.

platforms.name: TikTok
platforms.seoDescription: Paste a public TikTok video link to see the file options ReelFetch can prepare. Private accounts and removed clips are not downloaded.
platforms.headline: Download public TikTok videos
platforms.intro: ReelFetch checks public TikTok video links and lists downloadable qualities when TikTok provides them. Photo slideshows, private accounts, and deleted clips are not supported.
steps: Copy the link of a public TikTok video.
Paste it into the downloader above and choose Find Video.
Save a listed file to your browser downloads.
platforms.note: A TikTok URL proves the address shape, not that a video file is still public.
troubleshooting: Photo-only TikTok carousels do not contain a downloadable video stream.
Ensure the creator's account is public and the clip has not been removed or set to Friends-only.
If a short vm.tiktok.com link fails, open it in a browser first and copy the full tiktok.com/@user/video/... URL.

faqs.question: Can I download a TikTok video with ReelFetch?
faqs.answer: You can check any public TikTok video link. ReelFetch prepares a download only when that clip is publicly accessible.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch keep a copy of TikTok videos?
faqs.answer: No. The file is streamed for your download and temporary server data is deleted after the transfer.

faqs.question: Are private TikTok accounts supported?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch does not log into TikTok or access private accounts.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.seoDescription: Status and guide for Instagram Reels on ReelFetch. Unauthenticated server lookups are currently limited by Instagram login requirements.
platforms.headline: Instagram Reels & video status
platforms.intro: Instagram currently requires authenticated sessions for most media lookups from web servers. Because ReelFetch does not bypass login walls, Instagram downloads are marked Coming Soon.
steps: Instagram enforces login-gated responses for automated server requests.
ReelFetch never uses fake accounts or credential workarounds to bypass restrictions.
Use our supported platforms (Facebook, YouTube, TikTok) while we evaluate compliant options.
platforms.note: Stories, private posts, and unauthenticated Reels cannot be reliably retrieved from our server at this time.
troubleshooting: Instagram frequently returns an empty media response to unauthenticated server requests even for public Reels.
Ensure you are not attempting to download private profile content or Stories.
Check back for updates if Instagram introduces an authorized public embed/media endpoint.

faqs.question: Why is Instagram marked Coming Soon?
faqs.answer: Instagram blocks unauthenticated server-side extraction and requires login cookies. ReelFetch does not bypass platform authentication boundaries.

faqs.question: Can private Instagram posts be saved?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch does not log into Instagram and does not download private or restricted posts.

faqs.question: Is ReelFetch part of Instagram?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is an independent tool and is not sponsored by Instagram or Meta.

platforms.name: X
platforms.seoDescription: Status and guide for X (Twitter) videos on ReelFetch. Server-side X video extraction is currently marked Coming Soon.
platforms.headline: X (Twitter) video downloader status
platforms.intro: X (formerly Twitter) restricts unauthenticated media API access from server IPs. X video support is currently marked Coming Soon while we verify reliable public extraction.
steps: Verify the post on x.com or twitter.com actually contains an embedded video (not just a GIF link or image).
X frequently requires guest tokens or authenticated sessions that rate-limit server IPs.
Use Facebook, YouTube, or TikTok for currently verified downloads.
platforms.note: Text-only posts, image posts, and protected accounts never produce a video download.
troubleshooting: Confirm the tweet contains native video media rather than an external link preview or static image.
Protected/private X accounts cannot be accessed without logging in.
Server-side rate limits from X may prevent lookup completion.

faqs.question: Why is X marked Coming Soon?
faqs.answer: Unauthenticated server-side extraction from X is currently rate-limited and has not been reliably verified in production.

faqs.question: Can I download a post that is only text or images?
faqs.answer: No. Image-only or text-only posts cannot be converted into video.

faqs.question: Does ReelFetch represent X?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch is not affiliated with or endorsed by X.

platforms.name: Pinterest
platforms.seoDescription: Status and guide for Pinterest video pins on ReelFetch. Pinterest video support is currently marked Coming Soon.
platforms.headline: Pinterest video pin status
platforms.intro: Most Pinterest pins are static images or external links rather than hosted MP4 streams. Pinterest video support is currently marked Coming Soon.
steps: Check whether the pin is an actual video pin rather than a static image or Idea Pin.
Pinterest video extraction from server IPs is currently unverified and marked Coming Soon.
Static image pins are never converted into video files.
platforms.note: Image pins, Idea Pins without a video stream, and private boards are not downloadable videos.
troubleshooting: Many pins that look animated or link to external blogs do not host a direct video file on Pinterest.
If using a pin.it short URL, open it in a browser to see if it resolves to a video pin or an external article.
Private boards require login and are never accessible.

faqs.question: Why is Pinterest marked Coming Soon?
faqs.answer: Pinterest video pin extraction has not yet been reliably verified on our production server.

faqs.question: Will an image pin become an MP4?
faqs.answer: No. ReelFetch never turns a still image into a video.

faqs.question: Are pin.it short links recognized?
faqs.answer: Yes, pin.it URLs are recognized as Pinterest addresses.

platforms.name: Reddit
platforms.seoDescription: Status and guide for Reddit videos on ReelFetch. Reddit currently requires account authentication for server requests.
platforms.headline: Reddit video downloader status
platforms.intro: Reddit currently requires account authentication for automated server-side media requests, so Reddit downloads are marked Coming Soon on ReelFetch.
steps: Reddit blocks unauthenticated server requests with an authentication requirement.
ReelFetch does not use fake accounts or bypass platform access controls.
Use our verified platforms (Facebook, YouTube, TikTok) for active downloads.
platforms.note: Text posts, image posts, and quarantined or private subreddits never produce a video file.
troubleshooting: Reddit server requests currently return an authentication-required error on unauthenticated IPs.
External video embeds on Reddit (such as YouTube links) should be copied directly from the original video host.
Private or restricted communities cannot be accessed.

faqs.question: Why is Reddit marked Coming Soon?
faqs.answer: Reddit currently requires account authentication for server-side media extraction, and ReelFetch does not bypass login gates.

faqs.question: Are redd.it links recognized?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both reddit.com and redd.it domains are recognized.

faqs.question: Is every Reddit post a video?
faqs.answer: No. Image, link, and text posts do not have video files.
